The '''Belat system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Vilonis sector/Legends|Vilonis sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], notable only as a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] transit point. During a staff transfer from the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] to the cruiser [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], the convoy intercepted a distress call from the task force of ''[[Calico]]'' in a nearby location. Two [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] from [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], one of which was piloted by [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]], were dispatched to investigate.
